dataset: Smart Uzhavar — Tamil Nadu Agricultural Office Locations
accuracy_policy: No address, phone number, or coordinate is inferred from a block name.
Taluk is left null because the official LGD block export does not itself establish a simple Taluk-to-Block hierarchy.
Coordinates are included only where independently verified.
The LGD block list is administrative source data; it does not prove that an Agriculture office exists at every block.
